title: DevSuperSuite Enterprise RFP Compliance Matrix & Security Questionnaire Catalog
summary: Standardized machine-readable RFP question catalog mapping OmniKernel 5.2 architecture to SIG Core v2024, CSA CAIQ v4, VSAQ, NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5, and FIPS 140-3 compliance controls.

items.question: State the full legal corporate entity name, jurisdiction of incorporation, and headquarters location.
items.shortResponse: OmniKernel Labs Inc. (d/b/a DevSuperSuite Official), incorporated in Delaware (File #7421894), headquarters in San Francisco, CA.

items.question: Demonstrate vendor financial stability, operational runway, and solvency metrics.

items.question: Provide proof of Commercial General, Technology E&O, and Cybersecurity Liability Insurance coverage.
items.shortResponse: $15M Cyber Liability (AIG/Lexington), $10M Tech E&O (Chubb), $4M General Liability (Travelers), $10M Umbrella. Additional Insured endorsements issued within 24h.

items.question: Does the vendor provide source code escrow protection for enterprise customers?
items.shortResponse: Yes. Master Escrow Agreement maintained with NCC Group. Complete source code, build manifests, and cryptographic toolchains deposited and verified semi-annually.
items.evidenceDocument: NCC Group Tri-Party Escrow Verification Certificate (ESC-2025-NCC-789)

items.question: How does DevSuperSuite optimize context window usage and prevent token waste?
items.shortResponse: AVX-512 vector-accelerated Tree-sitter AST Context Slicing extracts public interfaces and strips implementation bodies into typed stubs, reducing context load by 83.51% in <1.4ms.
items.evidenceDocument: OmniKernel AST Compiler Benchmark Report (25-Repo Enterprise Test Suite)

items.question: What IDEs are supported, and is proprietary editor adoption mandatory?
items.shortResponse: Zero editor lock-in. OmniKernel acts as a universal Model Context Protocol (MCP) daemon, supporting Neovim, JetBrains, VS Code, Zed, Emacs, and terminal CLI.
items.evidenceDocument: MCP Universal Client Interoperability Specification v5.2

items.question: Can the software run in an isolated SCIF or air-gapped network with zero outbound internet egress?
items.shortResponse: Yes. 100% local silicon execution. Zero external network calls required for AST parsing or license checks (validated via offline Ed25519 asymmetric cryptography).

items.question: Describe the real-time voice interface architecture and latency specifications.
items.shortResponse: Sub-110ms duplex voice engine with local WebRTC AEC3 acoustic filtering, CPU SIMD ONNX Silero VAD, and 38ms instant verbal barge-in ('CROW').

items.question: What encryption algorithms and cryptographic standards are utilized?
items.shortResponse: FIPS 140-3 Level 3 compliant cryptography: Ed25519 signatures, AES-256-GCM symmetric encryption, BLAKE3 / SHA-384 hashing. Zero deprecated ciphers.

items.question: How does the system prevent accidental leakage of API keys and credentials into LLM contexts?
items.shortResponse: AgentShield hardware-accelerated Shannon entropy scan (H >= 4.50 bits/char) evaluates memory in <0.8ms, halting secret serialization with POSIX Exit Code 1.
items.evidenceDocument: AgentShield Entropy Detection Specification & Test Matrix (DSS-SHIELD-V1)

items.question: How does the vendor prevent autonomous AI agents from deleting unit tests to pass failing builds?
items.shortResponse: AgentShield enforces INVARIANT_TEST_PRESERVATION at the OS pre-commit hook level. Attempts to delete or disable existing test suites trigger POSIX Exit Code 2 and immediate rollback.

items.question: Provide details of recent independent third-party penetration testing.
items.shortResponse: Annual black-box and white-box penetration testing conducted by CREST-accredited firm (Bishop Fox / NCC Group). Q4 2025 assessment identified 0 Critical and 0 High vulnerabilities.

items.question: Is customer source code stored, inspected, or used to train public or proprietary AI models?
items.shortResponse: ABSOLUTELY NOT. Zero model training, zero cloud storage, zero telemetry egress. Source code is parsed strictly in transient host memory and never transmitted to vendor servers.
items.evidenceDocument: OmniKernel Data Processing Warranty & Zero Retention Schedule

items.question: Confirm compliance with GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and international data transfer frameworks.
items.shortResponse: Compliant with GDPR (EU/UK) and CCPA/CPRA. DevSuperSuite processes zero customer personal data on vendor infrastructure. Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) provided for administrative metadata.

items.question: State the vendor's RTO and RPO metrics for runtime execution and cloud licensing.
items.shortResponse: Runtime execution RPO is 0.00s (local git storage); RTO is <60s on replacement hardware. Licensing cloud portal RTO < 4h, RPO < 15m backed by multi-region replication.
items.evidenceDocument: Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery Plan v5.2

items.question: Provide the current SOC 2 Type II audit report and ISO 27001 certification status.
items.shortResponse: Active SOC 2 Type II attestation (unbroken 12-month period, zero exceptions, BDO/Schellman). Certified ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 27701:2019 ISMS.
items.evidenceDocument: AICPA SOC 2 Type II Report (FY2025-2026) & ISO 27001 Certificate

items.question: What is the vendor service availability SLA and critical incident response time commitment?
items.shortResponse: 99.999% cloud availability guarantee. 24/7/365 Tier-1 dedicated engineering support with <15 minute initial response SLA and <4 hour hotfix target for Critical (P1) issues.
items.evidenceDocument: Enterprise Service Level Agreement & Master Support Handbook

items.question: Detail the commercial pricing options and anti-SaaS lifetime license terms.
items.shortResponse: $29 Pro Lifetime License per seat (via Gumroad at gumroad.com/l/tlzdco) with zero recurring monthly fees. Enterprise Fleet licenses from $15,000/yr (250 seats) with 24/7 support and escrow.
items.evidenceDocument: Commercial Price Book & Lifetime Licensing Schedule (FY2026)

items.question: Does the vendor provide uncapped intellectual property indemnification?
items.shortResponse: Yes. Unconditional, uncapped IP indemnification defending against all third-party patent, copyright, and trade secret claims, backed by a clean-room engineering warranty.
